function.description: Use only when the user explicitly asks for the total number of configured mobility groups. This endpoint returns the aggregate mobility-group count and does not return group records or their attributes. For every other mobility request this tool is ineligible; use the structured mobility-group details API instead.
function.name: api_getMobilityGroupsCount

responses.description: Total number of mobility groups available.

count.description: Total number of mobility groups available.
